# Kerala Lottery Results Today (Frontend)

> A modern, high-performance web platform for live and archived Kerala State Lottery results, prize breakdowns, ticket validation, OCR/QR scanning, PDF result generation, and search functionality.

## Project Overview
- **Domain**: https://www.keralalotteryresultstoday.in
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router) + React 19 + TypeScript 5
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 + Material UI (MUI v9) + Emotion
- **Backend / Database**: Supabase (PostgreSQL + Realtime) & Local fallback cache
- **Key Modules**: Ticket OCR/QR Scanner (Tesseract.js & html5-qrcode), PDF Generator (pdfkit), Realtime Draw Countdown, Live Search, Claim Assistant, Admin Portal.

---

## Tech Stack & Dependencies

### Core Framework & Runtime
- **Next.js 16.3.0**: App Router architecture (`app/` directory), server & client components, dynamic routing, metadata generation, and API routes.
- **React 19.2.8 & React-DOM 19.2.8**: Latest React primitives, concurrent features, and server actions.
- **TypeScript 5.x**: Full strict typing across data models, components, and API handlers.

### UI & Styling
- **Tailwind CSS v4 (`@tailwindcss/postcss`)**: Utility-first responsive design, modern CSS tokens.
- **Material UI v9 (`@mui/material`, `@mui/icons-material`, `@emotion/react`, `@emotion/styled`)**: Accessible UI controls, date pickers, dialogs, drawers, and iconography.
- **Canvas Confetti (`canvas-confetti`)**: Interactive celebration animations for winning ticket matches.

### Data Layer & Storage
- **Supabase (`@supabase/supabase-js`)**: Remote database queries, structured lottery draws storage, real-time subscriptions, and remote sync.
- **Local Storage (`lib/ticket-storage.ts`)**: Client-side ticket watchlist persistence, saved numbers, and offline preferences.

### Forms & Validation
- **React Hook Form (`react-hook-form`)**: Controlled/uncontrolled form state handling.
- **Yup (`yup`) & Resolvers (`@hookform/resolvers`)**: Schema-based form validation.

### Utilities & Processing
- **OCR Engine (`tesseract.js`)**: Optical Character Recognition for reading physical lottery ticket numbers directly from camera/images.
- **QR / Barcode Scanner (`html5-qrcode`)**: High-speed camera barcode and QR decoding for ticket validation.
- **PDF Kit (`pdfkit`)**: Dynamic server-side and client-side PDF lottery result sheet generation.

---

## Project Structure

```
frontend/
├── app/                              # Next.js App Router root
│   ├── layout.tsx                    # Global root layout (MUI Provider, Navbar, Footer, SEO metadata)
│   ├── page.tsx                      # Homepage (Live results, countdown, prize tables, search, scanner)
│   ├── loading.tsx                   # Top-level fallback loading skeleton
│   ├── error.tsx                     # Global error boundary and recovery
│   ├── not-found.tsx                 # Custom 404 page
│   ├── globals.css                   # Global Tailwind CSS and custom animations
│   ├── sitemap.ts                    # Dynamic sitemap generator for all draw pages
│   ├── robots.ts                     # Search crawler instructions (disallowing /admin and /api)
│   ├── [code]/                       # Dynamic route for specific lottery code (e.g., /KR, /SS, /TH)
│   ├── lottery/                      # Detailed lottery subpaths
│   │   └── [code]/[date]/            # Archive and specific draw results by date
│   ├── search/                       # Historical lottery number search and match checker
│   ├── claim/                        # Prize claiming guide, tax calculator, and official procedures
│   ├── guide/                        # Lottery guide and information
│   ├── faq/                          # Frequently Asked Questions
│   ├── contact/                      # Contact and support page
│   ├── privacy-policy/               # Privacy terms and cookies disclaimer
│   ├── terms-conditions/             # Terms of service
│   ├── admin/                        # Secure administrative panel for manual draw entry/sync
│   └── api/                          # Next.js Serverless API Route handlers
│       ├── draws/                    # Fetch latest and historical structured draw data
│       ├── search/                   # Server-side number search query engine
│       ├── sync/                     # Supabase & upstream lottery data synchronization
│       ├── cron/                     # Scheduled cron jobs for automated scraping/syncing
│       ├── pdf/                      # PDF result generation endpoint
│       ├── admin/                    # Admin auth and draw publishing actions
│       └── indexnow/                 # Instant search engine indexing API (Bing / Yandex)
├── components/                       # Reusable React components
│   ├── Navbar.tsx                    # Top navigation bar with quick links, live ticker, watchlist toggle
│   ├── Footer.tsx                    # SEO-rich footer with disclaimers and category links
│   ├── MuiProvider.tsx               # Emotion/MUI SSR client theme provider
│   ├── ModernDatePicker.tsx          # Custom interactive date selector for past draws
│   ├── SavedWatchlistDrawer.tsx      # Slide-out drawer displaying user's saved lottery tickets
│   ├── ShareButtons.tsx              # WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook, and WebShare API integration
│   ├── ConsentModal.tsx              # User privacy & cookie preferences modal
│   ├── InitialLoader.tsx             # Smooth initial page loader animation
│   ├── ScrollRestorer.tsx            # Preserves user scroll position across navigation
│   └── skeletons/                    # Loading placeholder components for draw cards and tables
├── lib/                              # Core business logic, utilities, and integrations
│   ├── supabase.ts                   # Supabase client, TypeScript types, lottery schemas, query helpers
│   ├── theme.ts                      # Material UI custom theme palette and typography tokens
│   ├── lottery-sync.ts               # Background data sync and parsing logic
│   ├── ticket-storage.ts             # LocalStorage wrappers for watchlist tickets
│   └── admin-auth.ts                 # Admin authentication verification helpers
├── public/                           # Static assets, PWA icons, manifest, web banners, and llms.txt
├── scripts/                          # DB seed and utility execution scripts
└── next.config.ts                    # Next.js configuration and image domains
```

## Core Data Models & Schemas

### Weekly Lotteries (`lib/supabase.ts`)
| Day | English Name | Malayalam Name | Code | Type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monday | Bhagyathara | ഭാഗ്യതാരാ | `BT` | Weekly |
| Tuesday | Sthree Sakthi | സ്ത്രീശക്തി | `SS` | Weekly |
| Wednesday | Dhanalekshmi | ധനലക്ഷ്മി | `DL` | Weekly |
| Thursday | Karunya Plus | കാരുണ്യ പ്ലസ് | `KN` | Weekly |
| Friday | Suvarna Keralam | സുവർണ്ണ കേരളം | `SK` | Weekly |
| Saturday | Karunya | കാരുണ്യ | `KR` | Weekly |
| Sunday | Samrudhi | സമൃദ്ധി | `SM` | Weekly |

### Bumper Lotteries
- **XN**: Christmas New Year Bumper (₹20 Crore) - January
- **SB**: Summer Bumper (₹10 Crore) - March
- **VB**: Vishu Bumper (₹12 Crore) - May
- **MB**: Monsoon Bumper (₹10 Crore) - July
- **TH**: Thiruvonam Bumper (₹25 Crore) - September
- **BR**: Pooja Bumper (₹12 Crore) - November

### TypeScript Interfaces
```typescript
export interface FirstPrize {
  ticket?: string;
  location?: string;
  agent?: string;
  agency_no?: string;
}

export interface PrizeData {
  consolation?: string[];
  "2nd"?: string[];
  "3rd"?: string[];
  "4th"?: string[];
  "5th"?: string[];
  "6th"?: string[];
  "7th"?: string[];
  "8th"?: string[];
  "9th"?: string[];
  amounts?: Record<string, string>;
  guess?: string[];
  mc?: string[];
}

export interface StructuredDrawResult {
  id?: number;
  draw_date: string;       // YYYY-MM-DD
  draw_name: string;       // e.g. "Karunya"
  draw_code: string;       // e.g. "KR-682"
  lottery_code: string;    // e.g. "KR"
  first: FirstPrize;
  prizes: PrizeData;
  created_at?: string;
}
```

---

## API Routes Reference

- `GET /api/draws?date=YYYY-MM-DD`: Fetches structured lottery results for a given date.
- `GET /api/draws?code=KR&limit=10`: Fetches recent draws for a specific lottery code.
- `POST /api/search`: Query lottery database by ticket number (full or 4-digit last digits).
- `POST /api/sync`: Triggers sync pipeline with official state sources into Supabase.
- `GET /api/pdf?draw_code=KR-682`: Generates downloadable PDF result sheet.
- `POST /api/indexnow`: Notifies IndexNow API of updated draw result URLs for immediate search indexing.
- `POST /api/admin/publish`: Protected endpoint for admin to manually add/edit draw results.

---

## Key Conventions & Best Practices

1. **Next.js App Router Architecture**:
   - Server Components by default for optimal SEO and fast TTFB.
   - Use `'use client'` directive exclusively when client interactivity (hooks, state, event handlers, canvas, browser APIs) is required.
   - Use `generateMetadata()` on dynamic routes for rich OpenGraph, Twitter card, and structured JSON-LD schema tags.

2. **React 19 & Hooks Rules**:
   - Follow standard React 19 conventions; avoid deprecated lifecycle patterns.
   - Guard browser-only APIs (`window`, `localStorage`, `navigator.share`) with `typeof window !== 'undefined'` or `useEffect`.

3. **Styling & UI**:
   - Responsive-first design supporting mobile (360px+), tablet, and desktop viewports.
   - Use Tailwind CSS utility classes paired with Material UI components wrapped by `MuiProvider`.

4. **Performance & Reliability**:
   - Supabase client queries should implement proper error boundaries and fallback states.
   - Lazy load heavy client libraries (e.g. `tesseract.js`, `html5-qrcode`, `canvas-confetti`) to maintain fast initial paint.
